regime.call: Risk-on grinds higher as vol compresses, breadth narrows

liquidity.evidence: TGA fell $6,307B to $877,028B and bank reserves rose $22,484B to $3,013,794B, with NFCI at -0.560 and the liquidity composite at score 2 (easing).

volatility.evidence: VIX at 14.81 (-4.08%) and VIX9D at 12.27 (-8.36%) both hit 5-day lows, though SKEW rose 1.65% to 148.10.

confirms: VIX 14.81 and VIX9D 12.27, both falling for five straight sessions, confirm the vol-suppression leg of the call.
SOX +2.78% to 11,921.69 and BTC +6.24% to $81,172.94 show broad risk appetite across semis and crypto simultaneously.
Liquidity composite score 2 (easing) with TGA down $6,307B and bank reserves up $22,484B supports the easing-liquidity leg.
contradicts: RSP/SPY fell 0.61% to 0.2787 and IWM/SPY fell 0.59% to 0.3730, meaning breadth narrowed even as headline indices rose.
SKEW rose 1.65% to 148.10, near its 5-day high, showing tail-hedge demand building even as VIX fell 4.08%.

falsifiers.meaning: Would signal panic re-accelerating and invalidate the vol-suppressed, risk-on call.

falsifiers.threshold: HYG falls below $77 in one session (more than 1.5% down)
falsifiers.meaning: Would signal credit stress emerging and break the liquidity-easing assumption.

falsifiers.threshold: 10Y closes above 5.15% or rises more than 15bps in a day
falsifiers.meaning: Would signal hawkish rate fears intensifying, pressuring growth-stock valuations and challenging the risk-on leg.

regime.for_w52_engine: This week's gate is not at risk, and VIX at 14.81 sits well within the low-volatility band with no imminent band change evident, though rising SKEW (148.10) bears watching.
regime.confidence_reason: All three axes point risk-on/easing/suppressed, but narrowing breadth (RSP/SPY -0.61%, IWM/SPY -0.59%) and rising SKEW (148.10) keep the alignment from being fully clean.

review.yesterday_call: Panic fades rapidly after the hawkish hike lands
review.note: None of yesterday's falsifiers hit and all three axes extended in the same direction, so the call carries over, though the breadth/SKEW contradiction flagged yesterday is still unresolved today.

alert: SKEW at 148.10 is rising even as VIX falls to a 5-day low of 14.81, a classic pre-storm divergence worth monitoring.
